text: A captain swears every stack fights harder with a hero who has seen its kind before.
Drink at a well before a long march, the old soldiers say, and the spells come back to you.
A town with a marketplace pays better for ore the more marketplaces its lord holds.
The astrologers watch the turn of every week; some weeks a whole kind of creature multiplies.
Diggers who know where to look find the Grail beneath the obelisks' hints.
A castle's walls and towers have turned back armies twice their garrison's size.
Heroes who lost their armies come back to the taverns in time, hoping to be hired again.
Travellers say {strongest} fields the mightiest host in the land.
Merchants whisper that {richest} sits on the deepest treasury of any lord.
{mosttowns} is said to hold the most towns: {towns} of them.
A shepherd swears the {treasure} lies unclaimed somewhere in the {where} of the land.
They say a hero who walks the {where} will stumble on the {treasure}.
